status: Tooltip, Hover Card and Toggle Tip complete at assigned native/Lit boundaries; M17 complete
implementation: Shared native popover presence, Floating UI placement and owned Lit Motion effect lifetime
Tooltip preserves native focus targets, exact text, prior descriptions and a readable tooltip name; no plain-tooltip shadow
Hover Card keeps native destination activation; supplementary inert preview text supplies an accessible description
Toggle Tip composes native Buttons and an explicitly activated nonmodal dialog; keyboard focus, outside dismissal and cancelable close follow one owner
Native element references keep Toggle Tip names current when trigger text changes
Same-scope owned description mirrors integrate with the existing semantic bridge and preserve application/Field descriptions
Live trigger themes, public token overrides and direction reach the top-layer surface
Context Card, the old Tooltip interface, all corresponding style producers and the obsolete local palette controller are removed
Progress and documentation consumers use content; the Snippet preview uses Toggle Tip

verification.build: Strict package build passes for the accepted runtime source; final unreferenced style-producer cleanup is separately verified by the generator audit

corrections: Outside-focus dismissal must listen at the document: WebKit pointer clicks do not always focus the trigger first
Exit focus return is captured before inertness and retained through the owned fade; external focus remains external
A visible inert Tooltip body needs an explicit readable tooltip name in addition to the trigger description
Snapshot text did not update an open Toggle Tip name; native labelled-by element references now track the trigger
Playwright name/role queries do not fully account for these shadow references and inert slots; native Chrome accessibility results and actual focus provide the stronger oracle
Browser cases reset viewport, pointer and document URL so an earlier hover/fragment does not leak into the next case
Final producer audit found three independently named legacy trigger/backdrop maps; they are removed together with their outputs
limits: Actual Safari/assistive technology and generated React integration retain M22/M26 owners
Native accessibility tree inspection is Chromium-specific; all three engines additionally verify DOM references and actual focus
Final package/removal acceptance rebuilds and audits the complete distribution in M26
